content:
Plan for Phase 43: Cockpit hardening — a legible cycle (3.7). Plan at docs/phases/cockpit-hardening.md; roadmap entries for Phase 43 (In progress) and Phase 44 (saloon rethink, promoted, depends on 43) at docs/roadmap.md.

Problem (docs/cockpit-issues.md 2026-08-16, mapped mechanically 2026-08-17): a running handoff is not legible as a handoff — the only running signal is #chip-inflight (ignores inflight.kind); the Lead panel's .live box exists only while status=='running' and renderConversation wipes/rebuilds on `end`, discarding streamed lines; the Start card lingers until the lead's first state write (nothing reflects the pending `launches` row); the reviewer has no region (its log is reachable only via the manual, non-streaming tail drawer); events_signature omits conversation_turns/launches/log growth.

Plan (additive, no schema bump, no CLI change):
A. cockpit_api: activity_payload() — read-only merge (in-flight marker, usage rows, conversation_turns, gates, panels, pending/failed launches) normalised to one outcome vocabulary (running/finished/cancelled/failed/timed_out/process_gone/orphaned), keyed ids; now_payload gains turn_kind, launch, last_turn; events_signature adds conversation_turns/launches digests + in-flight log size.
B. server: GET /api/activity; GET /api/activity/log/<stem>/events (SSE over .tagteam/turns/<stem>.log, byte-offset ids, replay, end after marker release; shared line-poller with the lead SSE; stem validated, no traversal); /api/tail?stem=.
C. cockpit UI: Cycle region (Lead/Reviewer lanes, token on the owed side, running kind named) + Activity log (rows keyed by id, patched not rebuilt; running row streams; finished rows stay with outcome + [log]/[transcript]); Start → "starting" state from now.launch; strip names the in-flight kind + last outcome (#chip-last); tail drawer removed (folded into activity rows, cancel-turn moves there); Lead panel keeps a finished turn's lines under a <details> and points at the cycle activity when the lead is on a cycle turn; one OUTCOME_LABEL table.
D. Docs: HTW #cockpit/#lead, README cockpit section, cockpit-issues.md resolution note, one screenshot from the seed.
E. Tests: activity merge/normalisation/cap, now keys, signature coverage + cost, /api/activity + log SSE (replay/end/cap/traversal), launch pending→failed visibility, JS source guards (no innerHTML in the new block, ids present, btn-tail gone, OUTCOME_LABEL exactly seven).

Scoping call for round 1: the roadmap backlog said fold the saloon rethink into this phase; the plan keeps 43 to the evidenced legibility problem and promotes the saloon rethink as Phase 44 (depends on 43 — it consumes the per-role turn state + outcome vocabulary this phase exposes). Say if you'd rather fold it in (becomes scope §F, size large).

UX flow designed first with ux-design-guide (principles: visibility of status, match the mental model, one home for activity, Doherty). Success criteria in the plan §"Success criteria" (6 gates, all local).

Approved. The Phase 43 scope cleanly addresses the evidenced cockpit legibility failures with an additive read model, streamed persistent activity, and specific API/UI/source-guard coverage. Splitting the saloon rethink into dependent Phase 44 is the right scope boundary.
